description: Narrow Android-aligned contract derived from the Fluent Speech Commands benchmark.
execution_note: This contract is an evaluation target. It does not grant Android permissions or execute actions.
provenance_note: Only media-control and relative media-volume examples are mapped from the source labels. All other source intents are treated as unsupported and mapped to abstain by policy.

action.description: Start or pause active media playback.

tools.name: volume_adjust
tools.description: Adjusts the media stream volume by one step.

direction.description: Whether to increase or decrease the media volume by one system step.
